c.label: Stylized kid (child-safe)
c.prompt: A clearly stylized cartoon toy character of a child: chunky vinyl-figure proportions, oversized round head, simple mitten-like hands, matte toy-plastic finish with visible seam lines, painted-on facial features, wearing dungarees and a striped shirt, standing upright with arms slightly away from the body. Deliberately non-photoreal: a collectible vinyl figure, never a photographic human child.
c.directed: A single full-body stylized cartoon child toy, standing in a neutral A-pose with arms slightly away from the body and legs slightly apart. The character has chunky vinyl-figure proportions, an oversized round head with painted-on facial features, and simple mitten-like hands. It wears blue matte toy-plastic dungarees and a red and white striped matte toy-plastic shirt. The entire character has a matte toy-plastic finish with visible seam lines, characteristic of a collectible vinyl figure, deliberately non-photoreal. Full body in frame head-to-toe, centered, isolated on a plain neutral background, no props gripped or crossing the silhouette, one camera angle facing the character, even studio lighting, no cropping, no motion blur, no text or watermark, no collage or multi-view grid, no second character.
